entries.diff_text: Line 43: Line 43: __TOC__ __TOC__ ==Description== ==Description== The '''Scout''' is one of two starter towers obtained upon joining the game for the first time, with the other being the [[Sniper]]. The '''Scout''' is a starter tower. Its low cost makes it useful in the early game, but its low DPS limits its effectiveness later on. In [[PVP]], it deals significantly more damage than in regular modes, though it remains weaker than most alternatives. The '''Scout''' is very cheap in comparison to other towers, meaning it can be placed right from the start of the game. However, the '''Scout''' has low DPS, even at higher levels, meaning it is not effective later on during the game. In [[PVP]] mode, it has far higher DPS than in regular modes, though it is still lower than most other options. The '''Scout''' is considered an early-game tower due to its low cost and low overall damage. ==Upgrades== ==Upgrades==

entries.title: Engineer
entries.comment: Reverted edit by [[Special:Contributions/StrongestWolverine688|StrongestWolverine688]] ([[User talk:StrongestWolverine688|talk]]) to last revision by [[User:Mentin123|Mentin123]]
entries.diff_text: Line 41: Line 41: __TOC__ __TOC__ ==Description== ==Description== The '''Engineer''' is a hardcore tower that attacks enemies and builds sentries using scrap gained from damage. It costs and requires level 50, with a gamepass option. Its strong upgrades provide high DPS , making it an all-round tower. Placement is limited to six per player, or five in [[PVP]] . The '''Engineer''' is a hardcore tower that attacks enemies with a rebar launcher and can build various [[Sentry (Unit)|sentries]] within its range to assist with defense. It can be purchased from the store for {{Gem|4 , 500}} and has a level requirement of {{Level|50}}. The '''Engineer''' is also available through a gamepass for {{Robux|1,267}} . The '''Engineer''' has three range rings: the white ring is the attack range of the '''Engineer''', the yellow ring is the placement range for sentries, and the red ring is the deadzone range in which the '''Engineer''' cannot fire nor build sentries. The '''Engineer''' collects scrap when damaging enemies, with the amount of scrap obtained per shot being equivalent to the damage dealt to an enemy. The scrap fills up its ''Scrap Meter'', which can be seen above its tower icon in the upgrade box or when the player hovers over it. When its ''Scrap Meter'' is full, the '''Engineer''' will briefly stop attacking to build a sentry. Within upgrades, the '''Engineer''' will build stronger sentries, however, they will require more scrap to be built. If the ''Scrap Meter'' is filled up but the maximum number of sentries are placed, the '''Engineer''' will wait until a sentry is despawned or destroyed before building another sentry. There is a limit to how many sentries can be built. Sentries built by the '''Engineer''' are considered units, though they cannot move and can only be placed on the ground in the yellow range ring. They do have health however, which drains over time or decreases when hit by an enemy ability that deals damage, limiting the amount of time they can stay alive. The amount left before a sentry despawns can be seen with the duration bar above a sentry. The '''Engineer''' is considered an all-round tower due to its cheap placement cost, decent DPS on early levels and very expensive upgrades with extremely high DPS later on. The '''Engineer''' has a placement limit of six per player. This is reduced to five in [[PVP]] mode. ==Upgrades== ==Upgrades==

A great early game splash tower.|Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Golden Demoman''' is a splash damage tower that is an upgraded version of the [[Demoman]], obtained from the [[Golden Crate]] for {{Coins|50,000}}, if you own the [[Demoman]]. It can also appear in the Daily Skin Store for {{Coins|55,000}}. The '''Golden Demoman''' throws explosive golden grenades at enemies which deal medium damage within an explosion radius. To compensate, it has a rather fast firerate compared to other [[Splash Damage]] towers. It has no damage drop-off, so it deals full damage to all enemies within explosion radius. At Levels 0-2, the '''Golden Demoman''' takes one second to aim at an enemy before throwing its grenade. This only affects the damage for the first throw, as it means the '''Golden Demoman''' has to wait 0.8 seconds before throwing it. While it is aiming, it will lock onto one enemy until it throws the grenade, after which it can target a different one. Even after the targeted enemy dies, the '''Golden Demoman''' will continue targeting it, though its grenade will land slightly ahead of where the enemy dies, in order to hit the enemy should it be still alive and moving forward. The '''Golden Demoman''' will also continue to aim at a target enemy even if it leaves its range, allowing it to attack outside of its range. The '''Golden Demoman''' is excellent for clearing huge crowds, except for those immune to splash damage. It is relatively weak against major bosses, though it can be useful for clearing the enemies that spawn from some major bosses. The '''Golden Demoman''' is considered an early game to mid-game tower, though in late game it can be quite useful for AOE damage when multiple are placed down. The '''Golden Demoman''' can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] and [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, and has no placement limit. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Faster Pitch|Cost = {{Money|250}}|Image = [[File:Demoman Upgrade 1 New.png|100px]]|Information = +1.5 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] 1.95 > 1.8 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] Sell Price changes to {{Money|358}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 2|Upgrade Title = Golden Handshake|Cost = {{Money|1,150}}|Image = [[File:Demoman Upgrade 1 New.png|100px]]|Information = +8 Damage [[File:SplashDamage.png|20px|Damage]] 4.5 > 5 Explosion Range [[File:ExplosiveRange.png|20px|Explosion Range]] +Hidden Detection {{Hidden|Hidden Detection}} Sell Price changes to {{Money|741}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 3|Upgrade Title = Loose Cannon|Cost = {{Money|2,650}}|Image = [[File:Demoman Upgrade 2 New.png|100px]]|Information = +1.5 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] 1.8 > 1.1 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] +7 Damage [[File:SplashDamage.png|20px|Damage]] 0.8 > 0 Aim Time [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Aim Time]] 5 > 5.5 Explosion Range [[File:ExplosiveRange.png|20px|Explosion Range]] +Faster Projectile Sell Price changes to {{Money|1,625}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 4|Upgrade Title = A Thousand Exploding Suns|Cost = {{Money|7,750}}|Image = [[File:NewDemomanLevel3.png|100px]]|Information = +2 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] 1.1 > 0.45 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] +Stun Immunity {{Stun|Stun Immunity}} Sell Price changes to {{Money|4,208}}}} ==Statistics== {{neow| $DPS$ = Splash Damage / Firerate $CE$ = Total Cost / DPS $TP$ = $FNC-TOTAL-COST$ $COST$ = 875; It can also appear in the Daily Skin Store for {{Coins|55,000}}. The '''Golden Demoman''' throws explosive golden grenades at enemies which deal medium damage within an explosion radius. To compensate, it has a rather fast firerate compared to other [[Splash Damage]] towers. It has no damage drop-off, so it deals full damage to all enemies within explosion radius. At Levels 0-2, the '''Golden Demoman''' takes one second to aim at an enemy before throwing its grenade. This only affects the damage for the first throw, as it means the '''Golden Demoman''' has to wait 0.8 seconds before throwing it. While it is aiming, it will lock onto one enemy until it throws the grenade, after which it can target a different one. Even after the targeted enemy dies, the '''Golden Demoman''' will continue targeting it, though its grenade will land slightly ahead of where the enemy dies, in order to hit the enemy should it be still alive and moving forward. The '''Golden Demoman''' will also continue to aim at a target enemy even if it leaves its range, allowing it to attack outside of its range. The '''Golden Demoman''' is excellent for clearing huge crowds, except for those immune to splash damage. It is relatively weak against major bosses, though it can be useful for clearing the enemies that spawn from some major bosses. The '''Golden Demoman''' is considered an early game to mid-game tower, though in late game it can be quite useful for AOE damage when multiple are placed down. It could have also been bought via a gamepass for {{Robux|350}} during Spring 2020, and can most recently be bought again for {{Robux|799}}. The '''Swarmer''' deals damage by throwing beehives and later by firing bees, additionally applying a single stack of bees on an enemy.
